title: Jim Penniston told the beings come from 8,000 years in the future (Rendlesham)
summary: Mike Masters tells of Jim Penniston told the beings come from 8,000 years in the future (Rendlesham), about 1980 at Rendlesham Forest, UK, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Mike Masters says that during the 1980 events in Rendlesham Forest, England, where military men reported a strange craft, the beings told one of them, Jim Penniston, "we are you" and that they come from 8,000 years in the future. Masters says they told Penniston they were having trouble reproducing and were taking reproductive cells from people. If true, the visitors would be our own distant descendants.
